verse: pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena gurubhaktena kramagāḥ | tāsāṃ tu yoginīnāṃ ca pāraṃparyagatāni ca
vyomeśīnāṃ paraṃ divyaṃ labhate sādhakottamaḥ | tittastudyomyaṇaṃ piṇḍa kālikākramamuttamam
tārasvaṃ gṛdhvāntaṃ sā vai * tarā sarvadehinām | ekānekatayā bhinnā abhedī bhinnabhāvanī
etat sadrūpaṃ deveśi kathitaṃ tava bhārgaśam | gopayed yonivad yatnādaguptād narakaṃ bhavet
saṃhāraṃ tu idaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | antasthā *? smā? ṣānta vimarśasthā nirañjanā
yā pūjyā sṛṣṭicakrasthā kālī sarvārthanāyakī | sā vidyā tava vakṣyāmi vinimarṣakalena ca
sarvamantreṣu tat sāraṃ sarvajñeyeṣu cottamam | sarvopamāmatikrāntaṃ vākkramātītagocaram
amānā mānanīyā ca śivabhūtā parā kalā | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
śrotumicchāmi tattvena samayārthaprapūraṇī | vidyā sarveśvarī śāntā vada tattvaṃ yathāsthitiḥ
kathayāmi samāsena cakrasya paramāvidhim | mahāpitṛvane ghore mahāliṃge'aathavā hara
parāparepadaṃ paścāt saraditke padaṃ tataḥ | kalākalepadaṃ yojya śūnyaśāntapadaṃ tataḥ
svasvabhāvasamāviṣṭā jñānadāḥ parameśvara | śrībhairava uvāca ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu mūrtināṃ gūḍhaṃ sarvārthanāśanam
samayāṃ pūrayed rudra bāhyato vīranāyaka | gurupaṃktiryathārthato ādau pūjyā suyatnataḥ
varṇatrayodaśaṃ taṃ tu viddhi śatrunisūdana | sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīye na caturdaśamameva ca
nirāvakāśa śabdantu prakāśakastathāśiva | sṛṣṭiśvarī tato yojya prathamaṃ piṇḍarāṭ tataḥ
ratnākārā ratnagarbhā ratnakāntarabhāsakā  ||2/31 ||
astraṃ tu kālisaṃjñā *? kṣetrapālamataḥ param | tato divyāmadivyāṃ ca mānavīṃ gurusantatim
astināstipadairhīnā sthitirūpā krameṇa tu | antasthā bhūtasaṃghasya svarasya pararūpiṇī | arūḍharūḍhayormadhye uttarottaragarbhiṇī
madhyaspandarathārūḍhā asvarāmbarabhedinī | vādyantā ūrdhvagā kālī hayāntā tūṣṇīgāśrutā
atyantagahanaṃ  gūḍhaṃ guptaṃ  guptataraṃ param ||1/ 45 ||
sthiticakraṃ tu jānīyād ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu adhunā śṛṇu | sṛṣṭiprathamagaṃ varṇaṃ saṃhārādaṣṭameyutam
kathayāmi samāsena ambarāsvararūpiṇīm | yasya vijñātamātreṇa sa sthitijño bhaved dhruvam
ūrdhvaṃ bindudvayaṃ yasyā madhye bindudvayaṃ punaḥ | teṣu madhye sthitā kālī bhakṣakasya ca bhakṣikī
bhavāmi paramārthatve tad vadasva samāsataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu deva paraṃ guhyaṃ yoginīnāṃ mukhoditam
sthiti navamavarṇena śilayā lāṃcchitaṃ kuru | etat piṇḍākṣaraṃ rudra ādau tasmāt samuddharet
evaṃmahārthaṃparamaṃ kramasaṃsthaṃ su gopayet | akramastho mahāvīro gaḥ kaścid bhuvitiṣṭhate
tavādya  kathayiṣyāmi sarvasaṃhārakārakam  ||1/ 52 ||
kakalā kārgalārūḍhā daśasaptākṣarāntarā | parekokana he kādya kālākalmaṣva kālinī
2/? ghrātā ghrātā vinirmuktā jñānena samatāṃ gatā | ? pañcānāṃ svasvabhāvānāṃ tridhāmā sā vyavasthitā
śavarī kramadūtī ca khecakre śaktipuṣkale | pūjayet tāṃ vidhānena tato vidyāṃ prapūjayet
ānandapadamadhyasthe ābhāsānte namo'stu te | āhlādapadagarbhe tu vyāptirūpe namo'stu te
mukhyaṃtu sarvavidyānāṃ sarvasānnirmukārakam | sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sthitisthaṃ ca saṃhārakaraṇodyatam
catuḥṣaṣṭirmahābhīmāḥ sarvavīreśanāyikāḥ | mahāyogaistu vai rudra udyuktāstu vidhānataḥ
vyomeśyaśca tathā devyo vyomaśca pūjayet sudhīḥ | sācaniḥ kramadūtīśca śaktiḥ puṣkarameva ca
asya nyāsaṃ yathānyāyaṃ bāhyatastacchṛṇuṣva me | yena jñātena vai samyak sarvamantraḥ svabhāvataḥ
eṣā tu devadeveśi daśasaptākṣarādhikā | vidyāvidyeśvarī ghorā kālanirnāśanī śivā
galatālukamadhyasthā antaḥ yāti parā citiḥ | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
pūjānāmāni divyāni labhate puṇyavāgjanaḥ | teṣu labdheṣu vai rudra cakreśatvaṃ na durataḥ
daśasaptādhikaṃ viddhi varṇakālakṣayaṃkaram | eṣā tu paramā kālī daśasaptādhikākṣarā
tatastu  devadeveśi svabhāvapadagarbhagā ||1/ 63 ||
aṭane sarvajantūnāṃ haṭhajñānena khegatā | khaṇḍakhaṇḍakamadhyasthā khaṇḍakākārabhakṣikā
dvādaśānte navānte ca ṣaṭtriṃśānte namo'stu te | hṛtpadmakarṇikāntasthe jvālārūpe namo'stu te
nākāśaṃ na ca dīptaṃ vai na prabhāsaṃ na bhāsakam | na kṛṣṇaṃ na ca vai pītaṃ na raktaṃ lohitaṃ na ca
akṣarākṣaravarṇajñā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | kākacañcupuṭākārā kalmaṣaṃ kalayet tu sā
ādau tu svakramaḥ pūjyastato vidyāṃ samuddharet | saṃhāracakradeveśa trayodaśamamārgataḥ
tato nityoditāṃ bhīmāṃ amātrāṃ sarvabhāsakāṃ | mātṛkāśca bahiḥsthāpya prāṇasya ca muhurmuhuḥ
yasya vijñātamātreṇa sthitijño bhavate dhruvam | gāmihātve yathārthatve kathayāmi vṛṣāsane
na jñānaṃ na ca vijñeyaṃ melāpaṃ paramaṃ na ca | na sṛṣṭirna ca saṃhāraṃ sthitibhāsāvivarjitam
saṃhārakramage nityaṃ sṛṣṭirūpe namastu te | kandasthānagate nityaṃ kauṇḍalyākhye namo'stu te
sarvasyākṣararūpasya nakṣatrasya tathā vidhiḥ | bhāsayet sā parā kālī bhābhirugrābhitārakam
